Academic research · University of Dhaka

Research theses.

Two studies applying remote sensing, spatial analysis and quantitative methods to environmental and public-health challenges in Bangladesh.

01 / Master's thesis

MSc · Disaster Science and Climate Resilience

Water Quality Prediction of Buriganga River Using Remote Sensing Techniques

University of Dhaka · Thesis submitted February 2023 · Buriganga River, Dhaka

Combined 42 field-collected water samples with Sentinel-2 surface reflectance to investigate river water quality. Correlation and multiple linear regression identified spectral relationships for total dissolved solids (TDS) and total suspended solids (TSS), which were mapped across the river.

02 / Bachelor's thesis

BSc · Remote sensing & public health

Flood Inundation and Health Incidence in Louhajang, Munshiganj

Louhajang Upazila · Munshiganj, Bangladesh

Investigated the spatial overlap between satellite-derived flood inundation and reported health occurrences to identify areas of potential concern. Monthly health records were analysed by gender and age group to explore changes in incidence during and after flood events.

01 / MAPPING

Flood extent

Delineated inundated areas using satellite imagery.

02 / OVERLAY

Spatial exposure

Compared flood extent with health occurrence distributions to identify higher-risk locations.

03 / ANALYSIS

Temporal patterns

Examined monthly, age- and gender-disaggregated health data using descriptive statistics and correlation analysis.
